5. Screenshots: before and after

6. What was changed

  1. Roles: Company Admin = support team (everything); fleet manager and supervisor = requesters (raise tickets for vehicles in their group and sub-groups, comment, attach, confirm or reopen); support sessions view-only.
  2. Workflow rules: allowed status changes per role; Resolve requires a resolution note; Reopen requires a reason and restarts the SLA clock.
  3. Settings tab (support team): SLA hours per priority, automatic escalation on or off and to whom, auto-close after N days. Read-only until Edit; Save or Cancel.
  4. Automation: overdue tickets escalate one priority level and are reassigned (max 3 times); resolved tickets close automatically after the set days. Recorded as “System” in the history.
  5. From Alert: pick one of today’s alerts (demo, labelled) to open a pre-filled ticket; the ticket keeps the alert type, time and location.
  6. Attachments (up to 1 MB each), a notifications bell with unread count and “Mark all as read” (per user), and a Reports tab: SLA met %, average resolution time, escalated, reopened, from-alert counts, breakdowns by status, priority, category and assignee, and CSV export.
  7. Database: migration db/migrations/vehicle/010_ticket_workflow.sql (new columns, ticket_attachments, ticket_settings, ticket_notification_reads). Rules in tickets.ts with 13 unit tests (all pass).

7. Issues and blockers

  1. Rule conflict, resolved without waiting: the Alerts and Reports pages are the owner’s original files and must not be edited, so “ticket from alert” and the ticket reports were built inside Ticket Management.
  2. Shell notification bell is shared code (core owner approval needed), so notifications are a bell inside the ticket page.
  3. Bugs I caused and fixed in the same iteration (1.3 min fixing): an empty red error bar was always visible in Settings and dialogs; a reopened ticket still showed its old resolution.
  4. Known limit: escalation and auto-close run while someone with write access has the page open (no server job in the prototype yet).
